item.title: Judge halts renovations at Camp Mystic Guadalupe site as flood victim's family fights to prevent reopening
item.description: A judge blocked Camp Mystic from renovating or altering its Guadalupe site at the request of the family of one of the young victims of the devastating Independence Day floods.

item.title: 'Have hope, don't get paralyzed in fear'; Grief counselor talks moving forward after 6th Street shooting
item.description: When tragedy strikes, it can feel difficult, or impossible, to move forward in life. But when it's time to begin moving forward, taking baby steps and being with community is a good place to start, said Cathy Collins, Crime Victim Advocate with the Christi Center.

item.title: Agreement reached between state, Bastrop animal rendering plant over smell
item.description: The company said Friday morning that it was "committed to being a good neighbor and protecting the health and safety of our employees and the communities where we operate."

item.title: Amidst Trump endorsement battle, Paxton and Cornyn fight over SAVE America Act
item.description: President Donald Trump has announced he will endorse a candidate in the Texas Senate primary runoff, and incumbent Sen. John Cornyn and challenger Attorney General Ken Paxton are sparring online about who is most likely to secure Trump's agenda.

item.title: Austin Wildlife Rescue to open new intake site soon
item.description: Austin Wildlife Rescue to open new intake site soon

item.title: SXSW starts less than 2 weeks after 6th Street shooting. City leaders, police say they're ready
item.description: One of Austin's largest events of the year will kick off next Thursday, not even two full weeks after a mass shooting struck the downtown Austin area with tragedy and fear.

item.title: Dallas oil CEO says gas prices could hit '$5 or $6' per gallon due to US, Israeli war with Iran
item.description: When shipping through the Strait of Hormuz paused, oil prices shot up by approximately 30%.

item.title: 'God's grace' saved man hit by gunfire in West Sixth Street mass shooting
item.description: Thursday, Austin police released a trove of videos -- body camera footage, Halo cameras, 911 call audio and video from a car parked in a parking lot -- which included video showing the gunman after he had parked his car, got out with a rifle and can be seen shooting at a man running by.

item.title: 'Austin has lost a light': Mourners pack church for mass shooting victim's funeral
item.description: Around 1,000 people packed LifeFamily Church in southwest Austin on Friday, according to one estimate, to say goodbye to 19-year-old Ryder Harrington, one of three people killed in Sunday’s mass shooting that is being investigated as a potential act of terrorism.

item.title: Rain and storms ramp up Saturday; ramp down Sunday
item.description: A cold front will drop through Central Texas on Saturday bringing a focal point for the moisture and thunderstorms and bringing widespread, but not non-stop, rain to Central Texas. -- Nick Bannin
